docs.title: Lua Moon Phase Calculator
docs.text: This script calculates the current moon phase based on the Gregorian date. It uses Lua's built-in date and time functions.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository or download the script.
  2. Run the script using a Lua interpreter (e.g., lua main2.lua).

  3. The script supports CLI flags:

  4. --date YYYY-MM-DD : specify a date

  5. --json : output JSON
  6. --verbose : print extra info

Examples:

lua main2.lua --date 2026-07-27
lua main2.lua 2000 1 6 --json
lua main2.lua --verbose

Running tests:

lua tests/test_moon.lua
